title: Megurine Luka — Original Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How was that last song, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Your solo was so great, Luka!
I almost forgot when I was supposed to start singing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Come on Rin, why are you the one answering her?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But, she was just so good!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Look, everyone else says I'm right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, Rin, everyone, thank you.
I'm glad you all seem to have enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, our show is getting quite exciting, but let's take a break here for a moment.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whaaat? But I wanna hear the next song now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't you know that if you say that, Miku and the others will start panicking backstage?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Besides, Rin, didn't you say you wanted to go see the satellite venue?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! The place with the exhibition, right?! We can go there?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I was hoping I could ask you and MEIKO to introduce the New Breeze & Reboot Festival as part of our little break...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But if you're that intent on hearing the next song, we can drop the idea of going—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ahhh! I changed my mind, we can take a break! You all want to hear about the exhibition too, right?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, then as planned, let's have you two go see what the satellite venue is like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Leave it to us!
Let's go, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll also take a moment to explain it again for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In the satellite venue right next to where we're having this show, there's an exhibition called the New Breeze & Reboot Festival.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There are all kinds of works on exhibit there, with the theme being us VIRTUAL SINGERS.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like MEIKO and Rin have arrived.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, Rin, can you hear me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Yes, we hear you!>
Satellite Venue

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <At the moment, we're at the Doll Corner right by the entrance.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Each one is put together so intricately...
It feels like they might blink at any second.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. I'd like to take a nice long look up close as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Look, look! The outfit on this doll of me is super cute! I wanna wear this while I sing too.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Plus, this me looks kinda mature and is so pretty! Maybe this is how I look to the person who made it!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That, or maybe they made you look a little more mature with the idea that you'll be this way when you've grown.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Look, this Rin over here has such a big round face and eyes, so this one's a more childish, cutesy doll!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You're right! I like this me too!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh! The Illustration Corner is right next door! Let's go check that out too!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That's a good idea! Come on, let's go!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They're both totally absorbed in the exhibition.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I understand, though.
I'm very interested in the works on display as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We normally express feelings through our singing, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But the works at the exhibition aren't songs... And yet they're still expressing something through us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I want to see that with my own eyes and feel it for myself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How about you?
Has your curiosity been piqued?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The satellite venue will remain open for entry even after our show ends.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure it would be fun to take a leisurely look around it while basking in the afterglow of the show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it seems Miku and the others are finished getting things ready. But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin and MEIKO haven't come back yet, have they...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll go get those two, so you all enjoy listening to the next song, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll see you all later.
